description: The wind and swell on Puerto Rico's coast right now, as 787daily's On the Water section shows them (/conditions/): each CariCOOS shore station's and NOAA buoy's latest wind (knots, gusts, the direction it blows from) and each buoy's waves (feet, period, direction), every row with its age and stale past an hour (a stale row has no numbers: not read is not calm), and, for a region (north, east, south, southwest, west), the NWS coastal waters forecast's next period for its marine zone. Station readings, not conditions at a beach. For the call at a surf, dive or kite spot use get_conditions; for spots that suit a wind, find_wind_spots; for breaks that suit a swell, find_surf_breaks. Cite 787daily.com/conditions/, CariCOOS, NOAA NDBC and the NWS.

region.description: A coast; omit for every station (no zone forecast)
